questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks. It’s funny how every time he fails to apply the _________ and _________ the glass.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

It’s funny how every time he fails to apply the _________ and _________ the glass.
questions.solution: 'Brakes' will be used in the first blank because "apply the brakes" refers to using brakes to stop a vehicle or machine. This fits the context where the person fails to apply the brakes. 'Breaks' will be used in the second blank because the glass breaks, meaning it shatters or cracks.

questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. A. In the vast tapestry of human history, local histories are the threads that give texture and depth to the narrative. B. These stories, often overlooked in favour of grander national or global histories, are essential in shaping the identities of communities. C. Local histories encompass the unique experiences, traditions, and events of specific communities. D. By preserving and promoting local histories, we can foster a sense of belonging, pride, and continuity among community members.
questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. In the vast tapestry of human history, local histories are the threads that give texture and depth to the narrative.

B. These stories, often overlooked in favour of grander national or global histories, are essential in shaping the identities of communities.

C. Local histories encompass the unique experiences, traditions, and events of specific communities.

D. By preserving and promoting local histories, we can foster a sense of belonging, pride, and continuity among community members.
questions.solution: A: This is a good introductory sentence because it establishes the main idea of the paragraph—how local histories contribute to the larger historical narrative.

questions.question: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. The difference between successful person/and others is not/a lack of knowledge/but a lack of will.
questions.questionHtml:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The difference between successful person/and others is not/a lack of knowledge/but a lack of will.

options.html: The difference between successful person
and others is not
a lack of knowledge
but a lack of will.

questions.solution: A) The article 'A' will be used before 'successful' because 'successful' is an adjective and after 'person' is a singular countable noun. Hence the correct usage would be 'a successful person'. If the noun 'person' is made plural, then the sentence will be correct. That is, 'successful persons' can also be used instead of 'a successful person'.

questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. P. Social media was flooded with posts and advertisements, each one more eye-catching than the other. Q. But among these, a campaign called ‘Leave.EU’ began to stand out. The messages played on fears, hopes, and a sense of lost identity. R. ‘Leave.EU’ harnessed digital platforms to target individuals with calculated and data-driven content, shaping their perceptions and pushing them towards voting to leave the European Union. S. Imagine a summer evening in the United Kingdom, right before the Brexit referendum.
questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

P. Social media was flooded with posts and advertisements, each one more eye-catching than the other.

Q. But among these, a campaign called ‘Leave.EU’ began to stand out. The messages played on fears, hopes, and a sense of lost identity.

R. ‘Leave.EU’ harnessed digital platforms to target individuals with calculated and data-driven content, shaping their perceptions and pushing them towards voting to leave the European Union.

S. Imagine a summer evening in the United Kingdom, right before the Brexit referendum.
questions.solution: S starts with an imperative verb "Imagine", which sets the tone for the reader to visualize a scenario. It introduces the context and thus fits naturally as the opening sentence.
